o.text: From Arabic صَابُون (ṣābūn), from Latin sapo.

glosses: edge (the joining line between two vertices of a polygon)
ridge or top (of an elongated hill)

o.text:
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish صقال (saqal), from Proto-Turkic *sakal.
Cognate with Crimean Tatar saqal, Old Turkic [script needed] (sakal), Turkish and Gagauz sakal, Turkmen sakgal, Chuvash сухал (suh̬al).
From Proto-Turkic *igne, cognate with Turkish iğne, etc.
Izafet II compound of dil + arxa. Calque of Russian заднеязычный (zadnejazyčnyj).
From Russian от и до (ot i do).
Borrowed from Arabic مُرَبِّيَة (murabbiya), feminine of مُرَبٍّ (murabbin), from the active participle of رَبَّى (rabbā).
Borrowed from Arabic دَوْرِيّ (dawriyy). By surface analysis, dövr + -i
